 def rollup(samples):
-    """Aggregate sample dicts into per-metric summary dicts."""
+    """Aggregate sample dicts into per-metric summary dicts.

+    for metric in sorted(groups):

+            "mean": sum(value * weight for value, weight in zip(values, weights))
+            / weight_total,
             "min": min(values),

+            "weight_total": weight_total,
